dealbreakers.why: 'drawable for a year and a half' restates the filer's facility term from notes:110 in the analyst's own words; no calculator path supplies it and it is not a verbatim quote.
'drawable for up to a year and a half' is the same unquoted paraphrase of notes:110 ('one year and six months'); no calculator path supplies it.

The customer counts ('Two customers', 'one customer') are unquoted filer figures. Calling concentration.facts.6.value 'one customer' for fiscal 2025 has no support in any input: notes:26 names one customer only for the June 2025 periods.
'names two customers together where the comparative period named one, and a single customer' restates the counts in notes:26 and notes:25 outside a verbatim quote; no calculator path supplies them.

The anomaly leaves 'charge or a balance' unresolved, but notes:14 and note_history:41, which the notes reader reported, call the figure 'estimated remaining costs to complete for loss contracts as of' each date. That settles it as a balance.
The anomaly says the rows do not say charge or balance, then treats the figure as a loss 'recognised in the half'. notes:14 settles it as remaining costs to complete at each period end.
'two customers carry' uses the filer's customer count outside a verbatim quote, and no calculator path supplies it. This bears on the valuation-reading answer only.

items.why: earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income sits below history.years.0 and every other profitable year in earnings_versus_cash.history. The trailing growth paths check, and mdna:67 explains the half only.
ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year is slightly negative while ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year is about a doubling. mdna:67 speaks only to the first two quarters.

earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets is less negative than every annual trend_table accruals_over_total_assets cell. The denominators differ (average vs period-end assets), but the ordering holds.

receivables.balance_sheet_change, share_of_net_income and the DSO trend cells match. The mdna:67 quote is verbatim, and revenue_recognition_contract_assets_fact shows an unbilled build that a collections explanation cannot reach.
The inventory balance_sheet_change, share_of_net_income and a nil articulation_gap match the calculator. The notes reader confirms no carried prose explains inventory.

accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change exceeds cash_flow_statement_change by articulation_gap. liquidity_and_capital_capital_expenditure_unpaid_fact rises steeply against the prior-year half, a plausible resident of the gap.

earnings_versus_cash.smoothness bears out income moving less than cash ('below 1 means income moves less than cash'). But that block's own net_income series falls in several quarters, so 'climbed almost every quarter' overstates.

The numbers reader shows the unrealized derivative loss as a non-operating line and as a cash-flow add-back, plus the quarter's tax benefit against pretax income. notes:8 and notes:85 confirm, and tax_rate.effective_rate checks.
revenue_recognition_contract_assets_fact shows the half's contract-asset increase far above the prior-year half. mdna:67 credits the timing of collections, which cannot explain unbilled balances.
The days_sales_outstanding values and position_in_history strings in trend_table quarters-back-0, -1, -4 and years-back-0 match the anomaly exactly.

trend_table quarters-back-0 contract_liabilities_over_revenue is the lowest of the filled quarters and below quarters-back-4 and -5. terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities exceeds balances_a_year_earlier, and mdna:69 records deposit repayments.

notes:85 gives the 'net discrete benefit' from the stock-compensation deduction, offset by return finalization and HNTE. The numbers reader prints the quarter's tax benefit, and tax_rate.effective_rate checks.

estimates_and_discretion_employee_related_liabilities_fact shows a larger fall than the prior-year half, and mdna:31 and mdna:32 name the rising incentive and stock compensation. The benign payout-timing reading is offered.
'deal-contingent provisions' is verbatim in notes:101, and notes:8 gives the undesignated net liability. The numbers reader ties the asset and liability pieces to the income-statement line.

notes:14 and note_history:41 state the figure is remaining costs to complete for loss contracts as of each date. The charge-or-balance question the anomaly leaves open is settled by its own inputs; see dealbreakers.

The calculator and both insufficient trend items confirm no inventory-reserve or warranty tag in any period. notes:45 does print a warranty line in other current liabilities, which the anomaly could have used.
earnings_quality_prepaid_and_other_current_assets_fact shows the half's increase far above the prior-year half. notes:46 explains only the derivative asset.

Restructuring prints in both years, though it is shrinking. mdna:47 and notes:34 add an 'Acquisition-related and other charges' line, notes:82 a new extinguishment loss and notes:8 the undesignated swap, and input_8k.md holds no release.

terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure exceeds depreciation_and_amortization. free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple and history.years.0.free_cash_flow_simple are negative after positive history years, and mdna:71 guides higher.
The unpaid-capex fact, accounts_payable.articulation_gap and notes:110 all bear the claim out. The text's unquoted 'a year and a half' strikes it under dealbreakers.

The ratios.efficiency cells and accounts_payable.share_of_net_income match. That share uses the balance-sheet change, part of which (articulation_gap) never passed through the operating payables line.

terms.balances_now and balances_a_year_earlier supplier_finance_obligation match, and note_history:2 shows the higher March 2026 balance. The obligation is small beside terms.balances_now.accounts_payable.
notes:110 supports the facility and the issued letters of credit. The unquoted 'a year and a half' strikes it under dealbreakers.
mdna:69 places customer-deposit repayments in financing, and notes:45 shows the deposit line falling. Where the receipts were classified is genuinely absent from the inputs.
liquidity_and_capital_capital_expenditure_paid_fact and mdna:68 show the jump in sale proceeds, with no description of what was sold or any gain.

The SBC paths and mdna:32 check. In calculator_filings_only.json, free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted is simple FCF less SBC; calculator.json's same path also carries the applied unpaid-capex adjustment.

free_cash_flow_to_equity, its net_borrowing and free_cash_flow_simple reconcile, and terms.debt_now exceeds terms.debt_a_year_earlier. mdna:77 and the repurchase fact (none in the half) support the rest.

mdna:37 says 'primarily' FX, but the numbers reader shows a new unrealized derivative loss with none a year earlier. notes:34 vs notes:35 show 'Other, net' lower than a year ago, so FX cannot be the main driver.

ratios.liquidity.quick_ratio and current_ratio match, as do current_liabilities and cash in terms.balances_now and balances_a_year_earlier. The payables and other-liabilities facts support the composition.

notes:85 and mdna:40 support the discrete benefit. tax_rate.effective_rate and the net_margin, return_on_equity, return_on_invested_capital and net income year_over_year paths match.
The swap loss (notes:8) and extinguishment loss (notes:82) are supported. 'Larger foreign-exchange losses' rests on mdna:37 alone, and notes:34 vs notes:35 show 'Other, net' lower than a year ago.

The growth paths, operating_cash_flow_over_net_income, smoothness and quarters-back-0 contract_liabilities_over_revenue match, and mdna:69 supports the deposit repayments.

coverage.why: The quote gate dropped the accounting areas estimates_and_reserves and controls_audit_and_filing_signals and the financial path_to_distress reading, so those stand unanswered.

calibration.why: Each surviving accounting verdict tracks its anomalies: earnings_versus_cash 'weakening' over its conversion, accrual and working-capital items, and cash_flow_engineering 'concern' over payables and unpaid capex. The two dropped areas list anomalies but have no verdict to test.

valuation_reading.why: The calculator holds no price (market.missing), no reverse DCF (implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing) and no sensitivity grid. The reading reports each gap honestly but picks its two assumptions by distance from history, not from the calculator.
